`npm test` is green again: 517 of 517 pass. I fixed two source bugs and didn't touch any tests.

- **Commit 958d3ae (thousands separators in `formatMoney`):** the cents part was padded with `padEnd` instead of `padStart`. So 1 cent printed as `$0.10`, and 101 cents as `$1.10`. The fix is in `src/money.js`.
- **Commit 4188e9a (per-line discount groundwork):** `buildInvoice` set `taxable = subtotal`, so tax was charged on the amount before the order-level code was taken off. It now uses `subtotal - discount`, as it did at v2.0.0. The fix is in `src/invoice.js`.

The new `taxable` and `lineDiscounts` fields, the line-discount support and the other commits' work are all kept. The two bugs account for all 8 failures. The `render.js` failures were downstream of them.

I haven't committed anything.
